caption:
A soft deadline feels nice for a second. Then you are both stuck when they read it as not urgent and you meant today. Save this for the next time you are about to water down a real due time.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #difficultconversations

slides.label: Stop saying
slides.quote: “When you get a chance, can you send me the draft?”

slides.headline: It hides the <u>deadline</u>.
slides.sub: They hear “not urgent.” You mean “I need it today.”

slides.label: Say this
slides.quote: “Please send me the draft by noon today.”

slides.headline: Be kind and <u>specific</u>.
slides.sub: Don’t make them guess how fast you need it.

slides.headline: The first time you say it shouldn’t be the real time.
slides.sub: Practice it out loud with Steady.
